test_cases.name: happy_path_immediate_grant
test_cases.description: Request arrives with ample bucket tokens and RPM quota available, granting immediate permit with zero wait duration.
test_cases.input: Execute request for 10 tokens on rate-llm-primary with capacity 60, refill rate 5.0 tokens/sec, and max_rpm 60.

test_cases.name: burst_deficit_throttled_wait
test_cases.description: Bucket tokens temporarily depleted, triggering deficit wait calculation, non-blocking sleep with jitter, and grant after throttle.
test_cases.input: Execute request for 4 tokens on rate-llm-primary when bucket has only 2 tokens, with refill rate 2.0 tokens/sec.

test_cases.name: trajectory_budget_exhaustion_halt
test_cases.description: Cumulative tokens exceed max_trajectory_tokens ceiling, triggering TRAJECTORY_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED defect report and permanent trajectory halt.
test_cases.input: Execute request for 1200 tokens on rate-search-agent when cumulative tokens are 49500 and ceiling is 50000.
expected_output_patterns: === TRAJECTORY BUDGET EXHAUSTED: Limiter: rate-search-agent Ceiling: 50000 ===

test_cases.name: rpm_quota_throttled_wait
test_cases.description: Request count reaches max_rpm ceiling within rolling 60-second window, enforcing backoff pause until oldest request timestamp expires.
test_cases.input: Execute 11th request on rate-github-api with max_rpm 10 within 60-second window.

test_cases.name: backoff_timeout_exceeded_rejection
test_cases.description: Calculated wait time for depleted tokens exceeds max_allowed_wait_ms, resulting in immediate rejection with BACKOFF_TIMEOUT_EXCEEDED.
test_cases.input: Execute request for 2000 tokens on rate-batch-worker with refill rate 0.1 tokens/sec and max_allowed_wait_ms 10000.

test_cases.name: negative_token_request_error
test_cases.description: Permit request with non-positive token count immediately halts with NEGATIVE_TOKEN_REQUEST_ERROR defect report.
test_cases.input: Execute request for -5 tokens on rate-llm-primary.

test_cases.name: post_execution_usage_reconciliation
test_cases.description: Observed actual token consumption differs from reserved estimate, adjusting cumulative trajectory total and bucket balance.
test_cases.input: Reconcile actual usage of 1500 tokens after initial reservation of 1200 tokens on rate-llm-primary.
